title: Add meteor trail animation to cursor follower
context: Enhance the cursor follower with a meteor-style trailing animation. A history buffer of recent cursor positions drives N trail dots that shrink and fade the further they are from the cursor head, creating a comet/meteor visual effect.

tasks.title: Implement meteor trail dots in CursorFollower
acceptance_criteria: 12 .cursor-trail-segment SVG line elements render inside .cursor-trail-svg when enabled
Each segment has progressively decreasing opacity (0.70 at head, 0.00 at tail) and stroke-width (12px at head, 0.5px at tail)
Trail segments connect sequential cursor positions: segment i x1/y1 equals posHistory[i] and x2/y2 equals posHistory[i+1]
Trail segments have no CSS transition — they update directly via setAttribute each RAF
Trail segments are hidden (inside v-if='enabled') and not rendered for reduced-motion / coarse pointer users
All existing CursorFollower.spec.ts tests continue to pass
New spec tests confirm 12 .cursor-trail-segment elements render, opacity/stroke-width gradient, and segment connectivity
npm run type-check and npm run build-only pass
